_about: One Light challenge illustrations, v1.1. Lossless PNG source at 960x630 (3x of the 320x210 scene, aspect ~1.52:1), riso grain baked in — no live SVG filters ship. 'card' = with the dot (cold-open deck, the one light). 'journey' = dot-free (in-journey: day banner, first-contact background) so the pinned live sphere stays the one vermilion bead. Convert to WebP (q~82) + lazy-load at build. Regenerate any asset from ../render-scene.html (hash '#<id>,<dot|nodot>') off the engine riso-engine.js.

size.fit: cover for card vs the wider banner crop
